Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body: Masika goes Malkavian via Clan Impersonation. Madness network is in play. Masiak plays a First tradition on my turn, and every turn thereafter. At the start of my turn there are 5 First Traditions in play. Does the check for "burnt 6 from this effect" stack independently for each copy?

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Blooded wrote:
> Masika goes Malkavian via Clan Impersonation. Madness network is in play. Masiak plays a First tradition on my turn, and every turn thereafter. At the start of my turn there are 5 First Traditions in play.
>
Note that Masika must have become a Prince or Justicar somehow also, such as through merging or a vote. Also that none of this setup is germane to the actual question.)

> Blooded wrote:
> Does the check for "burnt 6 from this effect" stack independently for each copy?
>
Yes - First Tradition A remembers how many times you've skipped your turn because of First Tradition A, and how much pool you've burned because of First Tradition A.

[FZD 20130818]
>
> Pascal wrote:
> Each First Tradition "remembers" how many times you've skipped your turn or how much pool you burned to it. "This effect" refers to the effect a given copy of First Tradition introduces.
>
> With 2 First Traditions in play under your control, you can very much have skipped your turn twice to First Tradition A, and then skipped twice your turn to First Tradition B.
>

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body: SO if i have 1dt trad A, B and C in play, I skip turn with A, b and C don't even trigger, do they?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Blooded wrote:
> SO if i have 1dt trad A, B and C in play, I skip turn with A, b and C don't even trigger, do they?
>
Correct. If you skip your turn with A, this will count as "1 turn skipped" for A, but B and C will stay in the same state.
